meta.title: Warrantee Architecture and Flows
meta.classification: internal engineering documentation; no secrets or customer records
refresh_triggers: A route, API, database table, RLS boundary, background job, provider, deployment path, or major user journey changes.
A new public integration surface such as API, CLI, MCP, OpenAPI, or agent discovery is introduced.
A security or ownership boundary changes.
A provider is added, removed, or changes operational status.

rules: Do not reuse another company's credentials, analytics property, CRM records, deployment project, or content.
Confirm repository, domain, deployment project, and database project before any external write.
Never place secret values, personal information, customer documents, or production record contents in this map.

system.purpose: Bilingual warranty and asset-lifecycle SaaS for consumers, issuers, approvers, sellers, buyers, and integration clients.
system.product_thesis: Warranty reminders and verification acquire usage; asset lifecycle intelligence is the long-term product.
system.architecture_style: Next.js App Router monolith with server route handlers, Supabase-managed identity/data/storage, provider integrations, and Vercel serverless delivery.

flows.name: Visitor to account and workspace
flows.terminal_outcome: Confirmed Supabase account, profile, and optional atomic business company membership.
flows.status: implemented; real acquisition not yet proven

steps.action: Visitor reads the offer and follows a signup CTA.
steps.control: Locale-aware campaign attribution is preserved.

steps.action: Request receives locale, security headers, and auth-route noindex policy.
steps.control: Open redirect and protected-route behavior are constrained.

steps.action: User selects signup and submits consumer or business identity fields.
steps.control: Password and input validation; signup intent is logged without personal data.

steps.action: Supabase creates and confirms the identity.
steps.control: Auth provider session and confirmation rules.

steps.action: Business signup atomically creates company and company-admin membership; consumer signup creates a personal profile.
steps.control: Database trigger and authoritative role mapping.

steps.action: A minimal contact/lead is synchronized without blocking signup.
steps.control: CRM failure cannot roll back user onboarding.

steps.action: Confirmed user enters onboarding/dashboard.
steps.control: Authenticated middleware and tenant policy.

flows.name: Personal warranty registration
flows.terminal_outcome: Owned warranty record with optional documents, certificate, QR, and reminders.

steps.action: Authenticated consumer enters warranty details or scans a document.
steps.control: Protected route and client validation.

steps.action: Server validates and creates an owner-bound warranty.
steps.control: Ownership fields are derived from the session.

steps.action: Postgres independently enforces row access.
steps.control: Forced RLS on critical tenant tables.

steps.action: Optional proof is stored privately and queued for security scanning.
steps.control: Size/MIME allowlist, path authorization, clean-download policy.

steps.action: Certificate and QR proof are generated for issued records.
steps.control: Public projection remains minimized.

steps.action: Expiry reminders and app notifications are scheduled from durable dates.
steps.control: Cron authentication and recipient ownership.

flows.name: Business issuance and approval
flows.terminal_outcome: Issued company warranty visible to authorized company members and the intended recipient.

steps.action: Active company membership and role are resolved.
steps.control: Company membership is authoritative; profile role cannot self-escalate.

steps.action: Issuer creates a company-bound draft warranty.
steps.control: Mutation requires issuer-company authority.

steps.action: Draft is submitted to the company approval flow.
steps.control: Compare-and-set status transition.

steps.action: Authorized approver reviews and approves or rejects.
steps.control: Approver/company-admin/platform-admin role gate.

steps.action: Issued or rejected state and audit history are committed atomically.
steps.control: RLS plus transition guards.

steps.action: Issued warranty receives certificate and QR proof.
steps.control: Only issued states cross the public proof boundary.

flows.name: Document upload and OCR extraction
flows.entry: Warranty creation, document page, or OCR endpoint
flows.terminal_outcome: Reviewed structured fields and a private scanned document linked to an authorized warranty.
flows.status: implemented; real private corpus remains external

steps.action: Upload request validates identity, ownership, file size, and MIME type.
steps.control: Private bucket and authorized object path.

steps.action: Untrusted file is stored privately with provenance metadata.
steps.control: No anonymous listing or download.

steps.action: Scanner records clean, rejected, failed, or pending state.
steps.control: Downloads can require clean status.

steps.action: Pipeline extracts embedded PDF text or invokes OCR.
steps.control: Timeouts, provider telemetry, and bounded input.

steps.action: Mistral performs primary OCR when configured.
steps.control: Pinned model and server-side key.

steps.action: Embedded text, optional Google Vision, or Tesseract provides fallback.
steps.control: OCR output remains assisted extraction, not unquestioned truth.

steps.action: User reviews extracted fields before durable warranty creation.
steps.control: Human confirmation.

flows.name: Inbound email to provisional warranty
flows.actor: Registered user forwarding a receipt or warranty
flows.terminal_outcome: Authenticated, deduplicated provisional warranty awaiting user confirmation.

steps.action: Resend sends a signed inbound webhook.
steps.control: Webhook authenticity and endpoint rate limit.

steps.action: Sender, envelope, token, attachment URLs, redirects, size, and duplicates are validated.
steps.control: Temporary trusted HTTPS URLs only; raw base64 is not persisted.

steps.action: Eligible attachments are extracted and parsed.
steps.control: Provider timeout and provenance.

steps.action: Ingestion job, attachment metadata, fraud signals, and provisional warranty are stored.
steps.control: Privileged service write plus admin/user access policy.

steps.action: User reviews, edits, confirms, or rejects the provisional record.
steps.control: Authenticated ownership and explicit confirmation.

flows.name: Claim lifecycle
flows.actor: Warranty holder, issuer, or authorized claims actor
flows.terminal_outcome: Authorized claim reaches a valid terminal state with immutable event history.

steps.action: Authorized holder creates a claim against an accessible warranty.
steps.control: Warranty ownership/company access is checked.

steps.action: Optional claim evidence is stored privately.
steps.control: Claim attachment inherits warranty authorization.

steps.action: Authorized actor requests a transition.
steps.control: Explicit transition graph and role checks.

steps.action: Server-only atomic RPC locks the row, changes state, writes claim event and audit record.
steps.control: No UI-only authorization.

steps.action: Relevant user receives an update.
steps.control: Recipient is derived from durable ownership.

flows.name: Approved warranty extension purchase
flows.terminal_outcome: Paid extension atomically renews the warranty; refunds/disputes are recorded.
flows.status: implemented but requires a real approved seller/provider offer

steps.action: Eligibility and latest approved extension policy are resolved.
steps.control: Direct zero-price platform fallback is disabled.

steps.action: Holder selects a seller/provider-approved offer.
steps.control: Purchaser, amount, currency, dates, and ownership are server-derived.

steps.action: Stripe Checkout collects payment.
steps.control: Server-side secret and same-origin return URLs.

steps.action: Signed webhook is claimed idempotently.
steps.control: Lease-based claim/complete/fail phases.

steps.action: Atomic RPC verifies payment details and updates extension and warranty state.
steps.control: Duplicate, mismatch, refund, and dispute paths are explicit.

flows.name: Public product passport verification
flows.terminal_outcome: Verifier receives authentic, minimized proof for an issued warranty only.

steps.action: Verifier opens a QR or enters a reference.
steps.control: Public lookup rate limit.

steps.action: Public API resolves the warranty by safe reference.
steps.control: Only issued states are eligible.

steps.action: A minimized public projection is read.
steps.control: No private storage path or full serial disclosure.

steps.action: Public certificate endpoint returns eligible proof.
steps.control: Certificate is tied to issued state and public policy.

flows.name: API / CLI / MCP tenant integration
flows.terminal_outcome: Scoped, rate-limited, tenant-bound machine operation with usage evidence.
flows.status: API and hosted MCP active; public npm distribution postponed

steps.action: Logged-in user reads the guide and chooses required scopes.
steps.control: No username/password is provided to integrations.

steps.action: Server creates a one-time visible token and stores only its hash/prefix.
steps.control: Expiry, revocation, scopes, and user ownership.

steps.action: API or CLI sends a scoped operation.
steps.control: Fail-closed scope check, tenant authorization, and rate limit.

steps.action: MCP uses public read-only tools or delegates authenticated tenant tools to the same policy.
steps.control: Destructive operations require explicit confirmation.

steps.action: Privacy-safe usage metadata is recorded.
steps.control: No token secret or private document content is logged.

flows.name: Contact and seller lead intake
flows.terminal_outcome: Durable Warrantee lead/support state, owner notification, and non-blocking CRM contact.

steps.action: Visitor submits a validated contact or seller form.
steps.control: Same-origin and contact rate limit.

steps.action: Server sanitizes fields and classifies the inquiry.
steps.control: No test contacts without explicit approval.

steps.action: Support ticket or seller application is persisted first.
steps.control: Internal record remains source of truth if providers fail.

steps.action: Minimal contact/lead is idempotently upserted.
steps.control: CRM is non-blocking and contacts/leads only.

steps.action: Owner or invited seller receives transactional email.
steps.control: Email domain and provider readiness checks.

steps.action: Privacy-safe conversion event is recorded.
steps.control: No names, emails, phones, or message bodies in funnel metadata.

flows.name: Expiry reminder and notification delivery
flows.terminal_outcome: Eligible owners receive deduplicated reminder state and configured delivery.

steps.action: Daily schedule calls the protected expiry endpoint.
steps.control: Cron secret.

steps.action: Service queries expiring warranties and intended recipients.
steps.control: Durable ownership and bounded date window.

steps.action: Notification and audit rows are inserted idempotently.
steps.control: Duplicate reminders are suppressed.

steps.action: Transactional email is sent when configured.
steps.control: Provider readiness and no-send probes.

steps.action: Optional push/WhatsApp channel is used only when configured.
steps.control: Channel configuration and authenticated route.

flows.name: Agent discovery and public read-only routing
flows.terminal_outcome: Agent understands Warrantee, reads canonical resources, and prepares but does not autonomously submit an inquiry.

steps.action: Agent finds llms, cards, skills, API catalog, OpenAPI, and Markdown negotiation guidance.
steps.control: Only public canonical resources are exposed.

steps.action: Agent calls public overview, service, capability, matching, area, or resource tools.
steps.control: Public MCP is read-only.

steps.action: Crawler/resource/tool use is logged with privacy-safe metadata.
steps.control: No personal information.

flows.name: Source change to verified production
flows.terminal_outcome: Exact commit is deployed and its critical production journeys pass with disposable QA cleanup.

steps.action: A scoped change is committed and pushed.
steps.control: Identity lock, review, no unrelated file inclusion, rollback commit.

steps.action: CI runs source, security, build, agent, and browser gates.
steps.control: Failure blocks a verified release claim.

steps.action: Vercel builds and deploys the exact commit.
steps.control: Production project and custom domain identity.

steps.action: Live smoke, RLS, operational E2E, agent Markdown, and controlled load execute.
steps.control: Disposable QA identity is created, recursively removed, and verified absent.

steps.action: Release errors and regressions are monitored.
steps.control: Do not close an incident on deployment success alone.

security_controls.name: Authentication
security_controls.implementation: Supabase Auth with secure strict session cookies, recovery, OAuth/magic link/password flows, and callback redirect validation.

security_controls.name: Tenant isolation
security_controls.implementation: Personal ownership plus active company membership enforced in application queries, forced RLS, and private storage policy.

security_controls.name: Machine credentials
security_controls.implementation: One-time token display, hash at rest, prefix, scopes, expiry, revocation, rate limits, and usage logging.

security_controls.name: Request abuse controls
security_controls.implementation: Upstash-backed fail-closed rate limits, same-origin mutation validation, input schemas, and size limits.

security_controls.name: File safety
security_controls.implementation: Private buckets, MIME/size validation, provenance, hashing, scanner state, quarantine, and controlled download.

security_controls.name: Webhook and workflow integrity
security_controls.implementation: Stripe signature verification, idempotent event leasing, signed inbound email, and atomic database RPC transitions.

security_controls.name: Browser hardening
security_controls.implementation: HSTS, CSP, frame denial, no-sniff, strict referrer policy, permissions policy, and protected noindex behavior.

security_controls.name: Retention and minimization
security_controls.implementation: Bounded retention of raw ingestion/OCR/API/webhook data and minimized public/analytics/CRM projections.

known_constraints.detail: Paid Pro checkout remains unavailable until a live approved price and STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID are configured.
known_constraints.impact: Free and non-Pro product paths remain available; subscription revenue cannot launch.

known_constraints.detail: CLI source, packaging, and release checks are ready, but the package is not publicly published to npm.
known_constraints.impact: API and hosted MCP remain usable; users cannot install the CLI from npm.

known_constraints.detail: Repository security gates cannot substitute for an independent third-party penetration test and signed report.
known_constraints.impact: Do not claim independent security certification.

known_constraints.detail: Synthetic and redacted local fixtures exist, but real approved receipts, invoices, poor scans, handwriting, multilingual layouts, and corrupted files are still required.
known_constraints.impact: Do not claim validated production OCR accuracy across real document populations.

known_constraints.detail: Production is technically healthy, but acquisition, activation, retention, language demand, and extension conversion are not proven by real non-QA traffic.
known_constraints.impact: Product-market and conversion conclusions remain hypotheses.

known_constraints.detail: Web Push and Twilio WhatsApp code paths exist but are not part of the core launch proof unless provider configuration and approved usage are verified.
known_constraints.impact: Do not represent optional channels as universally active.

non_negotiable_invariants: Warrantee scope only; never mix another company, account, property, repository, database, or CRM data.
Do not treat a page load or deployment success as end-to-end proof.
Do not bypass Supabase Auth, tenant authorization, RLS, private storage, scopes, rate limits, or explicit confirmation boundaries.
Do not expose secrets, token values, customer records, documents, private storage paths, or personal information.
Do not make visual website changes without owner approval.
Preserve English and Arabic behavior, mobile usability, RTL, accessibility, and canonical production redirects.
Keep CRM synchronization non-blocking and limited to contacts/leads unless the owner approves a broader data contract.
Never provide integration clients with Warrantee usernames or passwords; use scoped integration tokens.
Keep public MCP read-only for unauthenticated agents; submitting or changing data requires explicit user authorization.
Keep npm publication postponed until the owner explicitly reverses the decision.
